title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: Sennheiser 421's (18th row - Center) > Sony TC-D5 > Master Cassette > Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x1)  > EAC(tracked with Addawav & CDWav) >SHN

ai_review.summary: Mixed‑quality recording of a celebrated Madison Square Garden show where Jerry’s crisp guitar and vocals shine, but the audio is poor and the Touch of Grey encore is missing.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for an inspired setlist and Jerry Garcia’s sharp playing and strong voice, especially on Fire. Reviewers note that the recording itself is a “travesty,” with unclear source quality and audible flaws, and the Touch of Grey encore is absent from this release.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality receives high marks for setlist and Jerry’s performance (≈4.5/5), while recording quality is criticized as poor (≈2/5). Weighted combination yields ~3.4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recordings as a travesty, with inconsistent clarity and overall bad fidelity; no specific source (soundboard/audience) is identified.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans consider the setlist a dream‑wish list for early ’80s MSG shows, though the missing Touch of Grey encore disrupts the flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for crisp, sharp guitar work and fantastic vocal tone; slight crack noted during Fire.
